resources.string: A connected keyboard can make editing templates easier. Templates are included in backups.
A format the receiver cannot take plays as silence, so switch it off again.
A soft click for the arrows and OK in every interface and menu. Not used during playback.
Add it to your phone\'s home screen to use it like an app. If the TV\'s address changes (after a router restart), scan again.
Add your key in API keys
Addon catalogs for Live TV are chosen in Settings > Addons & catalogs.
An example source. Open a title first to preview its real sources.
Android does not let apps stop the Home button, so Home cannot ask first. Picture-in-picture keeps the video playing in a corner where the TV supports it.
App names under app icons and folders
App order, visibility, folders, artwork and Light choices are saved separately for each profile.
Applies only while the presentation is open.
Apps taken off Home or hidden, and Ember Light page tiles you hid. Show one to put it back.
Ask first shows Stop watching? with Keep watching selected. Pressing Back again leaves, so a double press still exits.

Auto follows the performance profile. Choose a glass style independently of image quality. Low uses tint only; Medium caps effects at prepared blur. Liquid needs Android 13+ and falls back to Frosted on older devices. Colour separation stays off.
Automatic keeps Ember\'s controls and tries compatibility playback when a format needs it.
Back to the last video: for 4 hours after you leave a video part-way, press the chosen key on Home to continue where you stopped.
Blur unwatched episode artwork until it is watched or marked watched. Titles and descriptions remain visible.
Cache storage only. Saved lists, connections and playback files are kept.
Card and text spacing, independent of Home app circles.
Change the key in API keys
Changing this choice keeps both sets of saved activity; it does not merge or delete them.
Changing this duration clears the corresponding cache.
Choose a genre, a maximum age certification, or both. Titles without required metadata stay hidden.
Choose colours independently of the interface. Charcoal is neutral grey; Android TV uses Google TV\'s own navy and blue; Red adds a dark red palette.
Choose Home, an app, an input or a presentation. Child profiles stay on Home.
Choose movie and show details independently of your Home interface and player controls.
Choose navigation for Ember. Ember Light uses navigation icons in its app grid.
Collections are now in Settings > Home > Widgets & collections.
Control Ember from your phone\'s browser: search, pick a source, play and pause, seek, volume, your lists, and a keyboard for typing on the TV. It stays on until you switch it off.
Control supported apps from Light Home or the quick menu. No listening history is stored.
Copy to my badges and edit
Decoder preferences below apply to Standard playback. Compatibility has its own decoder controls while watching.
Discover, collections, media libraries and episode lists load their next page when you reach the end. Off shows a Load more button instead.
Downloaded images reload as needed after clearing.
Ember is the default media-focused Home. Ember Light uses an app grid with movable navigation icons. Navbar, media-page and player layouts are chosen separately.
Ember X uses a dark cinema Home layout. Navbar, media-page and player styles are configured separately. Colour themes remain independent.
Explore is shown by default. Catalogs and Collections appear when content is available. A manual choice stays saved until you restore automatic defaults.
First is the main one. Up to three.
For apps and media cards. Low-performance devices and reduced motion keep a static focus cue.
For interlaced Live TV or older video in Compatibility playback. Automatic follows the video\'s scan type; Always is for streams detected incorrectly. Uses more processing. Off is the default.
Google TV draws solid panels and buttons, like stock Android TV: no blur, highlight or edge, and the lightest on the TV.
Hidden: rows show only the catalog\'s title
Higher keeps subtitles above a projector\'s masking or a scope screen\'s bar.
Home: keep playing in a small window
If the browser says it can\'t make a secure connection, type the address exactly as shown, starting with http:// (not https://).
Latest successful signed public beta build. Downloads use nightly.link; APKs expire after three days.
Leave resolution matching off to let the projector\'s own scaler handle 1080p; turn it on to send 1080p as 1080p. Needs a TV or box that offers those modes.
. Live TV is hidden while a content lock is active.
Load a pack from a link
Local history, resume positions and remembered audio/subtitles. Connected tracker accounts remain shared across profiles.
Loop photos and videos. Selected local files must remain available; settings backups keep the playlist but do not copy large media files.
Maximum reuse time; providers can require earlier refresh.
Navigation, dock, menus and media buttons share one glass material. Labels and focus indicators stay sharp.
Needs a paid key (tier 1 or higher).
No completed source requests in this session yet.
No patterns yet. Add one, start from the Detailed badges, or send a pack from Settings > Phone setup.
Off by default. Automatically turns off after 30 minutes, when you leave this page, or when Ember leaves the foreground.
Off by default. Manual filters and saved searches remain available.
Off by default. Turning off also deletes this profile’s history.
Off by default. Works on your home network while Ember is running.
Off: sources show the title, Ember\'s tags and the badges above. On: your own name and description templates, AIOStreams-style.
One choice sets image quality, effects and glass together. Auto picks Low, Medium or High from this TV\'s memory and lightens effects if navigation is slow.
Only explicitly published public beta releases.
OpenSubtitles.com with a key adds release names, frame rates, trusted uploaders and hearing-impaired flags; add your login for more downloads a day.

Optional: describe what to watch, then review and apply ordinary Discover filters. Only your typed description is sent to Mistral; no profile or watch history. Requires Mistral and TMDB keys; provider charges may apply.
Paintings come from the Cleveland Museum of Art and Space from NASA.
Poster artwork language, where RPDB has one.
. Prepared backgrounds are shared and reused until the image changes.
Press Back twice suits remotes without a Play button. Quick settings also starts with a Back to … tile unless this is Off.
Published beta builds from the public Ember repository. No token required.
Published releases from the public Ember repository. No token required.
Puts the settings on %1$s back to their defaults. Ember restarts.
Recent request timings from this session. Source names, URLs, credentials and raw errors are omitted.
Recent searches are stored for each profile after submitting typed or voice input. They are included if you export an encrypted settings backup.
Remove Kids content locks before removing the PIN.
Rows of folder tiles on Home and Discover; each folder opens one or more catalogs.
Show a check on watched movies, completed shows and episodes. Hold OK on a title to change its watched mark.
Software includes FFmpeg and MPEG-H. MPEG-H outputs stereo PCM. AC-4 uses the device decoder when available.
Stable updates use published releases. Actions APKs are available after a successful beta build. Turning beta off returns to stable releases when a newer build is available.
SubDL adds a second large library.
Switch tabs on or off. Home and Settings are always there.
The addon\'s name after each catalog\'s title, such as Popular · Cinemeta, on Home and Live TV.
The Apps widget. Its place among Home\'s widgets is set in Widgets & collections.
The Apps widget on Home. All your apps show by default, as many as fit; hold OK on an app on Home to move it.
The badge shows under every source whose name or details match. Colours, a picture and more are in its options after adding.
The first patterns come first under each source. Press OK on one for its options.
The first source of the title you opened last.
The guide comes from the playlist (url-tvg) or the Xtream server unless you give a link, and refreshes every 12 hours.
The page that lists every app.
The rest are ranked by how closely their release name matches the source (group, source such as WEB-DL or BluRay, resolution, edition), frame rate, uploader trust and downloads.
These options apply when Appearance > Interface is Ember Light.
Tile colors use already-loaded images. Artwork backdrops are optional for media rows and collections; the featured hero keeps its artwork.
Titles and progress under movie and show cards
To change a Detailed badge\'s colours, picture or pattern, copy them to your own badges.
Trailers are stereo (no Atmos), and fetching streams this way is against YouTube\'s terms.
Tunneled playback gives tighter A/V sync on some TVs; turn it off if video stutters or will not start.
Turn off a kind to remove its text under the tiles. Names are still read out by accessibility services.
Type a word (for example subtitles, Atmos, PIN, Trakt or theme); the pages that have it are listed.
US TV ratings are used as a ceiling; movies use G, PG, PG-13 and R equivalents. Genre alone is not an age restriction. Other apps keep their own parental controls.
Use a direct link to the font file, such as one from Google Fonts\' GitHub. The built-in player always uses it; the advanced player uses it when it can read the font.
use channel up and down (or Up and Down) to change channel, and Info for the playback panel.
Use \"choose myself\" only if your receiver can play a format that the HDMI link does not report (common with ARC).
Using the free key. It gives the default style only.
Using the TV\'s caption style: the TV\'s own colours and outline replace these.
Wake launching requires Ember to be the active Home, or its Home button service to be enabled.
What Back and Home do while a video plays.
When server markers are missing, send only the IMDb ID and episode numbers to IntroDB. Community timings can differ between releases. Skip intro Off disables lookups.
YouTube changes often, so this can stop working until Ember is updated; when it fails, the YouTube app opens instead.
These settings go back to their defaults and Ember restarts.
